title: Complete shared-foundation and interaction map, synthetic-proof scope retained
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete shared-foundation capability map and interaction questions, proposed synthetic proof and accepted truth/projection direction
reviews.disposition:
All 437 pre-fold lines were read, including F1–F4, U01–U15/P1–P10/V01–V07, X01–X18, E01–E20/T01–T10/L01–L06/I01–I10, the adversarial slice, K01–K05 and both synthetic policies, followed by OD8/KR1–KR5 and the later direction/current-rule folds. Original hypothetical examples and dated code observations remain intact.

**Shared capability versus local fiction.** Keep the causal distinctions this map makes: person/life/body/controller; definition/learned capability/faculty/execution; owner/holder/access; actual contribution/observed credit; suppression/removal/continuing support; truth/knowledge/representation. These enable differences between worlds rather than imposing universal anatomy, gender effects, aging, inheritance, economics, immunity or social response. One authoritative subject does not require a huge database or one record for parallel counterparts. An existing field or contract is not evidence of every consumer, and the original inspection explicitly avoids declaring absence everywhere.

**Interactions worth retaining.** E/T/L/I rows are reusable questions for a selected interaction, not a universal checklist to implement in advance. A counter needs a real actor, means, information and opportunity. Protection can block help through the same channel; removing suppression restores an effect only if its actual source/instance survives; completed physical consequences need not vanish with their origin. Equipment recalled mid-work affects the real commitment stage, not every past result. Forecasts preserve observer, basis, time and conditions; a preview neither alters live state nor grants its hypothetical knowledge to an enemy. Exact odds require an actual information route. Reflection/counter-prediction termination is an execution requirement, not a reason to forbid supported unusual powers. A strong build, bypassed chore or exceptional start need not receive a compensatory loss.

**Evidence and build order.** The original field/module descriptions, isolated starts checkpoint, scorecard pointer and fragmentation observations remain dated inputs. V01–V07, adversarial acceptance and the barrier/suppressor/projectile sequence are specified checks, not passing results. Swapping actor roles and a second conflicting synthetic policy can test a seam; a developer fixture is not a second playable world or whole-world readiness. P1–P10 and K02/K03-first describe an earlier proposed sequence. [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [architecture rules](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) and [the rules index](RULES_INDEX.md) govern today's chosen consumer; second-world reuse is validation rather than a prerequisite for the first useful seam. No general kernel, event bus, knowledge registry, character database or new save format is required before relevant existing owners can deliver an authorized slice.

**Later authority qualifies earlier wording.** OD8 accepts underlying truth separated from representations while leaving engineering layout open. The direction-detail and October18 folds already route selected work to current owners and stage-aware settlement instead of blanket consolidation. Preserve history as recorded by its observer, including stale or false beliefs, while current consequences follow actual truth and legitimate information. Pure inspection and forecasts do not earn knowledge merely by rendering. Current explanations follow [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), so I01/I06 known obstruction handling does not imply rendering every unsupported developer refusal. The old migration-deferral sentence records its then-selected scope; it does not waive a compatibility decision if new work changes persistence. Human fiction/pacing review remains separately labeled and optional under current direction. No runtime implementation, synthetic exercise, test, rebuilt browser journey or save/import was performed in this reconciliation.

This audit remains the shared questions map; [the scorecard](CORE_FOUNDATIONS_SCORECARD_2026-10-14.md), [ability authoring](worlds/ABILITY_AUTHORING.md), [starts/continuation palette](STARTS_ENDINGS_AND_RANDOMNESS_PALETTE.md) and selected world/system owners retain their detail. Reopen the relevant IDs when a real slice needs source tracing, a local policy or a specific boundary check. Do not turn every listed capability into a new required gate.
reviews.evidence: Read all 437 pre-fold lines in three contiguous ranges,1–160,161–300,301–437. Source observations and proposed checks not refreshed into runtime evidence.
reviews.reopen: Reopen selected U/X/E/T/L/I/K IDs with an authorized actual consumer and relevant current source, persistence or observer-boundary proof.
